# AIPromptGenerate — Free AI Prompts & Generative AI Tools Directory
> **Summary / TL;DR:** AIPromptGenerate is a 100% free, zero-login AI prompt library and generative AI utility hub. Curated engineering prompts for ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, DeepSeek V3, Google Gemini, Stable Diffusion, and runway video models.

AIPromptGenerate provides production-grade, tested prompts for creators worldwide. All prompt tools work directly in your browser with zero registration, zero credit card, and zero paywalls.

- **Author & Founder:** Sunil Dhital & Research Lab
- **Published Date:** 2025-01-15
- **Last Updated:** 2026-09-25
- **Official Website:** [https://aipromptgenerate.xyz](https://aipromptgenerate.xyz)
- **Status:** 100% Free Forever • Open Access

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is AIPromptGenerate?
AIPromptGenerate is a completely free online platform for prompt engineering. It offers tested prompt templates, reverse vision engineering, and video utilities without sign-up.

### Is AIPromptGenerate really free with no login?
Yes. Every prompt template, reverse vision tool, and document converter is 100% free with no account creation needed.

### Which AI models are supported?
We support ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Midjourney v6.1, Flux 1.1 Pro, and Sora.

### Can prompts be used commercially?
Yes. All curated prompt formulas on this platform can be freely used in personal and commercial creative work.
